description: Checklist for vaults/connectors/accountants that use external strategy, lending, margin, or precompile-reported account state as backing, TVL, solvency, surplus, or settlement input.
core_invariants: external-account value used by local gates must equal net equity, not gross visible assets
all upstream liability, borrow, debt, held, pending, or encumbered fields must be classified before crediting assets as backing
a local settlement/mint/withdraw gate must fail when the external account is net negative even if one asset-side field is positive
trust_boundaries: local accounting variables vs external precompile/API state
gross supplied/collateral balances vs borrow/debt liabilities
spot total balances vs held/locked/spendable balances
off-chain strategy claims vs on-chain safety gates
common_bug_classes: gross supply counted as backing without borrow liabilities
held or margin-encumbered balance treated as spendable
external account state schema partially decoded
settlement or yield gate consumes an asset-only adapter value
connector TVL omits debts, fees, slashing, or pending losses
check_items: List every external reader feeding totalAssets, totalBackingSigned, surplus, solvency, collateral ratio, or yield distribution
For each reader, write the complete upstream response schema and classify every field as asset, liability, held/pending, price, metadata, or unknown
Search for sibling borrow/debt/liability endpoints when the local reader name says supplied, collateral, balance, or TVL
For every credited external asset field, identify the exact code path that subtracts matching liabilities before value-moving gates
Add a negative-equity test: positive supply/collateral plus larger borrow/debt must make surplus or solvency non-positive
Separate trusted-operator bad-parameter theories from contract-side gate failures caused by omitted liability fields
test_ideas: mock external state with supplied=100 and borrow=150, then assert distributableSurplus() <= 0
mock spot total=100 and hold=100, then assert bridge/withdraw availability is 0 if only free balance is spendable
toggle a registered external strategy slot from zero debt to nonzero debt and verify share price/surplus decreases
fuzz asset/liability decimals so debt subtraction uses the same valuation domain as supplied assets
